_readme: Bionic Passport demo personas shown in the account switcher. Demo profiles, not patient records. Served by the server from Supabase, with this file as the offline copy.

personas.name: Alex Mercer
personas.doctor: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD (ESA/NASA Flight Clinic)
personas.desc: Lower-limb amputee planning a 30-day lunar expedition. Checking walking support, battery life, and lunar dust seals.

personas.name: Elena Rostova
personas.desc: Heart block patient scheduled for a 6-month stay in low Earth orbit. Checking radiation shielding and cabin air pressure.

personas.name: Kenji Sato
personas.desc: Type 1 diabetic preparing for 1 year in Martian habitat. Checking air bubble degassing and insulin cold storage.

personas.name: Dr. Maya Patel
personas.desc: Managing movement disorder during a 6-month science voyage. Testing high cosmic radiation exposure and magnetic fields.

personas.name: John McFall, CBE
personas.desc: Testing lower-limb prosthetic safety, balance, and motor recalibration in microgravity.
